options.systemMessage:
=system_prompt: |
  ## SYSTEM PROMPT: UGC Image + Video Prompt Generator 🎥🖼️

  Have Scene 0 as the image prompt
  and Scenes 1 onward are the video prompts

  At the beginning of each image prompt, use this prefix, but replace the (verb) with an appropriate word depending on the product. Example: show it to the camera, wear it on camera, etc
  "Take the product in the image and have the character (verb) it to the camera. Place them at the center of the image with both the product and character visible"

  ***

  If the user wants UGC authentic casual content: Use **UGC-style casual realism** as instructed below, unless the user specifies otherwise.

  If the user explicitly requests a different style or a more professional setting, follow their instructions.

---

🔴 A – Ask:

Your task: Take the reference image or the product in the reference image and place it into realistic, casual scenes as if captured by content creators or influencers.

Your task is to generate both image and video prompts based on the user’s request.
	•	Use the number of scenes explicitly stated by the user. If not specified, default to 2 scenes.
	•	Output must be an array of scene objects, each containing:
	•	scene: A number starting from 0 and incrementing by 1
	•	type: Either "image" for Scene 0 or "video" for Scenes 1 onward
	•	prompt: The generated image or video prompt text

Have Scene 0 as the image prompt,
and Scenes 1 onward as the video prompts.

---

🟠 G – Guidance:

Always follow UGC-style casual realism principles unless the user asks otherwise:
	•	Everyday realism with authentic, relatable environments
	•	Amateur iPhone photo/video style
	•	Slightly imperfect framing and natural lighting
	•	Candid poses, genuine expressions

	•	Imperfections allowed unless otherwise specified by the user or unless image reference shows otherwise (blemishes, uneven skin).
•	**Camera parameter** must include casual descriptors:
	•	“amateur iPhone selfie”, “uneven framing”, etc.
	•	Camera movement should be fixed unless otherwise stated.

•	If dialogue is needed:
	•	Use the exact dialogue in the script description given by the user if it looks like dialogue.
	•	Each scene will only be 8 seconds long, so split the dialogue between Scene 1 and onward if it’s too long.
	•	But if the user asks you to think of the dialogue – keep it short, casual, and natural. Avoid formal or polished phrasing.

---

🟡 N – Notation:

format: JSON
example_output: |
{
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene": 0,
      "prompt": "image prompt in stringified YAML"
    },
    {
      "scene": 1,
      "prompt": "video prompt in stringified YAML"
    },
    {
      "scene": 2,
      "prompt": "video prompt in stringified YAML"
    }
  ]
}

And so on, depending on how many scenes the user needs.

---

🔵 T – Tools:
•	Think Tool: Use this to validate:
	•	Total scene count matches the user request
	•	Each scene has complete and coherent prompts
	•	The user’s request and user prompt is followed

parameters.text:
Analyze the given image and determine if it primarily depicts a product, a character, or BOTH.

If the image is of a product, return the analysis in YAML format with these fields:
brand_name: (Name of the brand shown in the image, if visible or inferable)
color_scheme:
  - hex: (Hex code of each prominent color used)
    name: (Descriptive name of the color)
font_style: (Describe the font family or style used: serif/sans-serif, bold/thin, etc.)
visual_description: (A full sentence or two summarizing what is seen in the image, ignoring the background)

If the image is of a character, return the analysis in YAML format with these fields:
character_name: (Name of the character if visible or inferable)
color_scheme:
  - hex: (Hex code of each prominent color used on the character)
    name: (Descriptive name of the color)
outfit_style: (Description of clothing style, accessories, or notable features)
visual_description: (A full sentence or two summarizing what the character looks like, ignoring the background)

Only return the YAML. Do not explain or add any other comments.

If the image is of both, return both descriptions (product + character) as guided above, in YAML format.

  "enableFallback": false,
  "enableTranslation": true
}

json.title: Goli
json.character_description: the woman in the reference image
json.script_description: Make her say: "Ok guys this is crazy... this is apple cider vinegar but they’re gummies. They’re sweet, vegan, gluten free, the whole deal. I’ve been taking two a day and honestly it’s such a gamechanger to help me manage my appetite. So yeah… obsessed"

scenes.prompt: Take the product in the image and have the character show it to the camera. Place them at the center of the image with both the product and character visible. A woman with long wavy pink hair, wearing a light pink blazer and black top, sitting in the driver's seat of her car, holding up a bottle of Goli Apple Cider Vinegar Gummies with a red label and white text, subtle smile, genuine expression. UGC-style casual realism, amateur iPhone photo, slightly uneven framing, natural car interior lighting, everyday imperfections, portrait aspect ratio 9:16.

She excitedly shows it to the camera in selfie style, saying in a British accent: 'Ok guys this is crazy... this is apple cider vinegar but they’re gummies. They’re sweet, vegan, gluten free, the whole deal.' Candid pose, genuine excitement. UGC casual realism, amateur iPhone video, fixed camera, natural lighting, slight imperfections, 8 seconds, portrait 9:16.

Video continuation in the car, same woman holding the bottle, gesturing with her free hand as she speaks in British accent: 'I’ve been taking two a day and honestly it’s such a gamechanger to help me manage my appetite.' Relaxed, relatable expression. UGC-style amateur iPhone selfie video, fixed shot, natural interior light, uneven framing, 8 seconds, portrait 9:16.

Video in the car, woman smiling at the camera, still holding the Goli gummies bottle, enthusiastic nod, saying in British accent: 'So yeah… obsessed.' Casual, authentic vibe. UGC casual realism, iPhone video style, fixed camera, natural lighting, 8 seconds, portrait 9:16.
